integrity: The full primary text was inspected through the Friedrichs interface conditions, the normalized kernel proof of the weakly degenerate reverse-Hölder theorem, and the explicit endpoint obstruction. The new endpoint follows by retaining the proof's pointwise |x|^{-alpha} gradient estimate and converting it to a distribution bound. Sharpness is certified by the exact harmonic profile used in the primary paper, whose distribution function is computed directly.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local Lorentz endpoint for intrinsic gradients of Friedrichs-harmonic functions in the one-dimensional weakly degenerate regime. It does not claim endpoint weak type for the global Riesz transform, does not treat the strongly degenerate separated-half-line regime, and does not claim a best numerical constant.
title: Sharp Lorentz endpoint for weakly degenerate Grushin harmonic gradients
